Three people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records.

SANDRA VERONICA SANDATE — Sandate was booked Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on an alleged charge of ASSAULT CAUSES BODILY INJURY-FAMILY MEMBER, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The arresting agency was the Laredo Police Department. No case number was listed in the booking record.

FELIPE PEREZ III — Perez was booked Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on an alleged charge of DRIVING WHILE INTOXICATED, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The arresting agency was the Texas Department of Public Safety. No case number was listed in the booking record.

JOSHUA COLE WOJCIECHOWSKI — Wojciechowski was arrested Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 2:54 a.m. on an alleged charge of DRIVING WHILE INTOXICATED, a Class B misdemeanor,. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record lists his city as Corpus Christi, Texas 78418. The arresting agency was the Laredo Police Department.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Each person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

*Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 21, 2026); Webb County public-access court records.*

*— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956*
